name: Fine
overview: The biblical concept of a fine, as shown in Exodus 22, involves restitution for theft or loss, often requiring the offender to repay double the value of what was taken or damaged. This system of penalties serves to uphold justice and accountability within the community, ensuring that wrongdoers compensate their neighbors fairly. Additionally, Leviticus 5:15 highlights a related principle of making an offering to the Lord for unintentional sin, demonstrating that fines or penalties also have a spiritual dimension in addressing offenses against God’s holiness.
